mam.configuration.title: %s Config
mam.configuration.timerEnabled.tooltip: Save on a timer while the world is open. Manual saves, shutdown, reload, and dimension changes are separate.
mam.configuration.intervalMinutes.toolti: Minutes between timed saves while timed saves are on. Vanilla saves about every 5 minutes; a longer interval writes to disk less often.
mam.configuration.saveOnReload.tooltip: Save after a successful /reload, once datapacks and structure templates have finished reloading.
Save when a player changes dimension, including returning from the End. Several changes in the same tick share one save.
mam.configuration.announceSaves.tooltip: Tell everyone in chat when a timed, reload, or dimension save finishes. Manual saves always reply to the player who asked.
